review: Let us be honest: I live in one of the least religious cities in Europe and my church has ninety people in it, and everyone I work with treats my faith as a personality quirk. I have stopped explaining. "Alte Worte sprechen noch" — old words still speak. My grandparents were church people under the DDR and lost careers for it, my parents dropped it entirely, I picked it up again at twenty-one and my mother took that as a verdict on her own life. Three generations in one sentence and this album is about exactly that. In German. Five stars.
